topic: An outdated website (old year in the footer, old hours, old photos) makes visitors doubt the business is still running. Three things to update.

scenes.label: your website
scenes.say: Your website still says twenty sixteen!
And visitors start to wonder: are you even open?

cards.title: The year.
cards.sub: A current date in the footer.

scenes.say: Want us to check yours? It's free!

caption:
"© 2016" in the footer. Opening hours from two summers ago. A price list nobody has touched since.

None of that is a big mistake. But a visitor can't tell an old website from a closed business, so they go and call someone else.

Three things you can update today: the year, your hours, your photos.

Want to know what else a visitor sees? We'll check your site and send three findings in writing, free. Link in bio.
